title: 第376章 新烬子爵第375章 谁有意见
slug: 迷雾求生从流民开始的领主之路
content_zh:
第376章新烬子爵
黑泥沼的秩序重建，比想象中还要快。
卡尔、西奥、盖尔、瑟琳娜和巴顿，这五位获得“烬冠敕赐”的封君，成了亚修横扫荒原的五柄尖刀。
甚至根本不需要亚修再亲自出手。
光是那五道远超寻常二阶的恐怖气场，敌方的士气便会如烈日下的残雪般崩解。
亚修并没有对他们赶尽杀绝，强行吞并他们的人口。
不是他突然心慈手软，而是受限于现实的规则。
新烬镇在吞并黑泥镇后，顺利晋升为LV.2【普通的城镇】。
但即便如此，本镇的人口上限也不过堪堪涨了一倍，达到两千人。
往下辐射，附属庄园的上限是三十座（其中可有十座晋升为2级），附属营地上限一百座。
满打满算，新烬镇如今能绝对控制的系统名册总人口，也就刚好一万人整。
而这片广袤的黑泥沼。
即便经历了连番战火与兽潮的消耗，散落在各处的庄民与野民保守估计也还有五六万之巨。
全吞下？
那根本吃不消，只会让新烬镇刚刚建好的秩序瞬间崩塌。
所以，亚修的刀锋只停在脖颈半寸处。
他不剥夺那些顺从者的庄园主头衔，只要求绝对的臣服。
交出三成的产出作为岁贡，并按比例承担新烬镇的兵役。
听话的，留下当看门狗；不听话的，连人带骨头一起嚼碎。
在生存与利益的双重安抚下，大批势力望风而降。

当然，新秩序的建立，从来少不了蠢货的鲜血来祭旗。
镇东百里外，三个自恃偏远、常年抱团的二级庄园结成了同盟。
他们拒绝上缴名册，甚至在各自的领地内大放厥词。
宣称亚修不过是仗着几件遗迹里挖出的高级装备狐假虎威，所谓的三阶，根本就是个为了恐吓众人捏造的谎言。
“亚修只是在虚张声势！他要是真有三阶的实力，早把咱们杀光了！还用得着跟咱们收税？”
这就是那几名叛党首领最后的底气。
然后，他们就迎来了新烬镇的雷霆镇压……
……
荒野上，迷雾翻滚。
其实亚修根本不需要亲自下场，叛军在卡尔等人的攻势下早就败局已定。
但他还是来了。
不是为了拼命，而是为了立威。
当那披着黑色大氅、提着长矛的身影从迷雾中缓缓踏出时，战场上出现了极其短暂的死寂。
紧接着。
“轰——”
“亚修大人！”
“新烬！新烬！新烬！”
排山倒海般的狂呼声从新烬军阵中轰然爆发，声浪甚至将周遭的灰霾都震退了数丈。
亚修单手倒提矛刃，神色冷漠地注视着对面已然面无人色的叛军首领。
他甚至没有拔出矛刃的意思。

漆黑的眸子扫过对面那三千多名临时拼凑的乌合之众，嘴角扯出一抹寡淡的讥诮。
“灰烬军势，敕召。”
“嗡——”
content_en:
Chapter 376 New Viscount Ember
The order of the Black Mire was reestablished faster than imagined.
Karl, Theo, Gale, Serena and Barton, these five lords who received the "Emperor of Embers" became Asher's five sharp knives across the wasteland.
There was no need for Ash to take action himself at all.
Just those five terrifying auras that are far beyond the ordinary second level, the enemy's morale will collapse like the remaining snow under the scorching sun.
Ash did not kill them all and forcibly annexed their population.
It's not that he suddenly became merciful, but that he was limited by the rules of reality.
After Xinjin Town annexed Black Mud Town, it was successfully promoted to LV.2 [Ordinary Town].
But even so, the town's population limit has barely doubled to two thousand people.
Radiating downwards, the upper limit of auxiliary manors is thirty (ten of which can be promoted to level 2), and the upper limit of auxiliary camps is 100.
After all calculations, the total population of the system roster that Xinjin Town can absolutely control now is exactly 10,000.
And this vast black mire.
Even after repeated wars and the consumption of beasts, the number of villagers and wild people scattered everywhere is conservatively estimated to be fifty to sixty thousand.
Swallow it all?
That's simply too much to bear, and will only cause the newly established order in New Ember Town to collapse instantly.
Therefore, Ash's blade only stopped half an inch from his neck.
He did not deprive those who obeyed of their title of lord of the manor, but demanded absolute submission.
Hand over 30% of the output as annual tribute, and bear the military service of Xinjin Town in proportion.
Those who were obedient were left as guard dogs; those who were disobedient were chewed up, including their bodies and bones.
Under the dual comfort of survival and interests, a large number of forces surrendered.
Of course, the establishment of a new order always requires the blood of fools to sacrifice the flag.
A hundred miles away to the east of the town, three second-level manor houses that relied on their remoteness and always stayed together formed an alliance.
They refused to hand over the roster and even made wild remarks in their respective territories.
Claiming that Ash was just pretending to be powerful by relying on the high-end equipment dug out from several ruins, the so-called third level was simply a lie fabricated to intimidate everyone.
"Ash is just bluffing! If he really had level three strength, he would have killed us all long ago! Does he still need to collect taxes from us?"
This was the final confidence of the rebel leaders.
Then, they ushered in the thunderous suppression of New Ember Town...
…
In the wilderness, fog rolled.
In fact, there was no need for Ash to end personally. The rebels had already been defeated under the offensive of Karl and others.
But he came anyway.
Not to fight hard, but to establish prestige.
When the figure wearing a black cloak and holding a spear slowly stepped out of the fog, there was an extremely brief silence on the battlefield.
Immediately afterwards.
"Boom——"
"Master Ash!"
"New Ember! New Ember! New Ember!"
An overwhelming roar erupted from the New Ember Army formation, and the sound wave even pushed back the surrounding haze several feet.
Ash held the spear blade upside down with one hand and stared at the pale-faced rebel leader opposite him with an indifferent expression.
He didn't even make any move to draw the spear blade.
His dark eyes swept across the more than 3,000 improvised mobs on the opposite side, and a faint sneer emerged from the corner of his mouth.
"The ashes of the army are summoned."
"Buzz——"
